facts.statement: Inject Enoxaparin 40 mg once daily at 6 pm for 14 days, with the last dose on 28 Oct 2026.
facts.label: Enoxaparin 40 mg: daily at 6 pm for 14 days

facts.statement: Take Paracetamol 1 g every 6 h, with a maximum of 4 g in 24 h.
facts.label: Paracetamol: 1 g every 6 h

facts.statement: Take Oxycodone 5 mg every 6 h only when needed for severe pain, with a maximum of 4 tablets per day, and do not drive while taking it.
facts.label: Oxycodone: 5 mg every 6 h

facts.statement: Take Omeprazole 20 mg daily before breakfast while taking pain medicines.
facts.label: Omeprazole: 20 mg daily before breakfast

facts.statement: Hold home naproxen until the surgeon review.
facts.label: Naproxen: hold until surgeon review

facts.statement: Keep the dressing dry and in place; you may shower from 17/10/2026 with the waterproof dressing on, but no baths or swimming.
facts.label: Dressing: keep dry, no baths

facts.statement: Go to the clinic for staple removal on 26 Oct 2026.
facts.label: Staple removal: 26 Oct 2026

facts.statement: Call 112 if you have calf pain or swelling, or sudden shortness of breath or chest pain.
facts.label: Call 112: calf pain, sudden breathlessness

facts.statement: Call the orthopaedic ward the same day if you have a fever over 38 °C, spreading wound redness, pus, or if the wound opens.
facts.label: Call ward: fever, wound redness

facts.statement: Do physiotherapy exercises 3 times a day and use the walker at all times for the first 2 weeks.
facts.label: Physiotherapy: 3 times a day

facts.statement: Use an ice pack for 20 minutes after exercises.
facts.label: Ice pack: 20 minutes after exercises

facts.statement: Attend the Orthopaedic clinic with Dr. Luis Herrera on 10 Nov 2026 at 9:15.
facts.label: Orthopaedic clinic: 10 Nov 2026
